<script>
/* Project videos. Playback starts here, never from markup: only on screen, never under
   reduced motion, and never after the visitor paused that video. Without JS the poster
   shows and the Pause buttons stay hidden. */
(function () {
  var items = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pj-vid'), function (f) {
    return { v: f.querySelector('video'), b: f.querySelector('.vid-toggle'), held: false, on: false };
  }).filter(function (it) { return it.v && it.b; });
  if (!items.length) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var apply = function () {
    items.forEach(function (it) {
      if (!mq.matches && !it.held && it.on) { var p = it.v.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {}); }
      else { it.v.pause(); }
      it.b.hidden = mq.matches;
      it.b.firstChild.nodeValue = it.held ? 'Play' : 'Pause';
    });
  };
  items.forEach(function (it) {
    it.b.addEventListener('click', function () { it.held = !it.held; apply(); });
  });
  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', apply); else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(apply);
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) { items.forEach(function (it) { if (it.v === e.target) it.on = e.isIntersecting; }); });
      apply();
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    items.forEach(function (it) { io.observe(it.v); });
  } else { items.forEach(function (it) { it.on = true; }); }
  apply();
})();
</script>
